name: LQDTY Liquidity Strategy
setup_rules: Core principle is LQDTY (liquidity): retail stop-losses cluster beyond the previous day's high and low, and large players fill bulk orders there.
Use the 1-day timeframe. Skip the running/current day candle. Mark the previous completed day candle only.
Draw two horizontal lines: previous-day high (upper liquidity) and previous-day low (lower liquidity).
Switch to the 1-minute timeframe for execution. Set alerts when price approaches either line.
If price stays between the two lines and never reaches a line, there is no trade.
Core logic is from the Gold video; numbers below are sized for ETHUSD futures on Delta (1m noise is much smaller than Gold).
This is a precious setup, not a session of 20-pip scalps. Some days have 0 trades, some have 2, some have 4.
entry_rules: Every entry is exactly 100 lots — same size on every trade.
Do not sell or buy only because price touches the previous-day high or low. Wait for confirmation, then the break.
SHORT: price must first reach or break the previous-day high. How far it runs above does not matter.
SHORT: wait for a FRESH 1m red candle (close < open) after that touch.
SHORT: the NEXT 1m candle must break that red candle's low. Enter SELL at that low. If the next candle does not break it, cancel and wait for a new fresh red.
SHORT stop: above that same red candle high.
LONG: price must first reach or break the previous-day low. How far it runs below does not matter.
LONG: wait for a FRESH 1m green candle (close > open) after that touch.
LONG: the NEXT 1m candle must break that green candle's high. Enter BUY at that high. If it does not, cancel and wait for a new fresh green.
LONG stop: below that same green candle low.
The signal candle does not need to wick the line. Confirmation can form after price has already gone through.
Do not require a close back inside the range, a session window, or a previous-day trend filter.
Skip only if the stop is unreasonably wide (wider than 20 ETH points).
If price stays between the two lines and never reaches a line, there is no trade.
exit_rules: Target 1: nearest relevant swing — swing low for shorts, swing high for longs. Exit 80 lots there.
Keep 20 lots as a runner for the next swing / larger move. After the partial, move that stop to entry.
If the runner is still open at the UTC day change, close it at the last price so it cannot block the next day's setups.
Do not trail. Never leave a 0-lot ghost position open.
risk_rules: Stop loss for SHORT: above the signal red candle high.
Stop loss for LONG: below the signal green candle low.
Always enter with fixed 100 lots. Partial 80 lots, runner 20 lots.
Maximum 2 full stop losses and 3 trades per session. Retry the same liquidity line after a full stop.
Skip if stop is wider than 20 ETH points.
Backtest on ETH futures (ETHUSD on Delta Exchange).
